text:
Sam: heads-up — embed-indexer alert flooded pages at 01:12 UTC, ~5 pages in 14m. opening a follow-up thread and linking the incident: https://incidents.redwood/14567
Priya: ugh saw that. looks like multiple regions flared simultaneously after a small rollout. dedupe didn't help because identity included pod_id.
Ethan: can you paste the rule? curious about expr/for/window.
Sam: rule snippet below:
```
alert: embed_indexer_error_rate
expr: sum(rate(embed_indexer_errors_total[1m])) by (pod_id,region) > 20
for: 30s
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/embed-indexer
```
Rosa: quick proposals: 1) change aggregation to service+region (not pod_id), 2) increase eval window to 5m, 3) implement hysteresis so we require a rolling 5m avg above threshold before paging.
Ethan: also suggest a suppression/backoff: collapse repeated pages from same identity into one page and increase mute window exponentially if it keeps flapping. that prevents firefighter pages during noisy rollouts.
Priya: agree. add a deploy-window exception: during known deploys, convert first N alerts to tickets and only page on sustained or escalating signals. we should be careful to keep true positives paged.
Sam: who can own infra-alerts PR? I can shepherd the runbook and paging wording.
Rosa: I can own the alert change + tests. ETA today EOD to open PR against infra-alerts.
Ethan: I'll review and add unit tests for suppression logic. also will file an observability ticket to track "pages_suppressed" and "pages_triggered" counters.
OpsBot: incident created: embed-indexer paging storm triggered 2026-09-02T01:12:04Z -> pages:5, resolved 2026-09-02T01:26:31Z, link: https://incidents.redwood/14567
Rosa: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pulls/911 — changes: group by service+region, eval window 5m, hysteresis: rolling_avg > 15 for 5m AND instantaneous > 25 for 2m before page, dedupe identity adjusted, suppression/backoff, deploy-window severity toggle. includes unit tests. PTAL @Ethan @Sam
Ethan: reviewing. minor nit on test naming; LGTM otherwise. will add obs ticket after merge.
Priya: paging policy proposal for runbook: - if alert resolves <12m -> ticket (no page) - sustained >=12m -> page - immediate page for explicit critical indicators (OOM, data-loss) - during declared deploy windows, first two occurrences -> tickets unless escalation criteria hit. document exceptions.
Sam: assigning owners & timeline: Rosa: PR + tests (today), Ethan: review + obs wiring (tomorrow), Sam: runbook update + postmortem update (tomorrow morning). Rollout plan: canary to staging 4h, prod gradual 10/30/60 next day if green.
Rosa: merged to main and canary-deployed to staging. monitoring. CI passed.
Ethan: opened obs ticket: https://issues.redwood/obs/4721 — will wire pages_suppressed and pages_triggered to dashboard next sprint.
Sam: staging 6h stable, no duplicate pages; pages_suppressed:2 recorded. scheduling prod rollout 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Priya: reminder to add metric that counts "pages avoided by deploy-window" so we can quantify how much noise the deploy exception prevents.
Rosa: will add that to PR follow-up if time permits. if not, will create an issue.
IncidentBot: follow-up: embed-indexer incident 14567 closed. root cause suspected to be small memory pressure + restart storm during canary. follow-up actions assigned in this thread.
Sam: Action summary:
- Rosa: implement rule changes & tests (merged to main, staging canary done)
- Ethan: review + observability counters (ticketed)
- Priya: craft paging policy wording & exceptions (drafting)
- Sam: update postmortem with owners/timelines and reconvene at next oncall to verify noise reduction (7 days)
Rosa: prod rollout in progress 09:05 UTC. watching dashboards.
Sam: prod at 100% 09:30 UTC, no new pages. will keep the pinned dashboard for 7 days and report back. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
